info.title: Ordinary business entry HTTP contract
info.description: A02A module-root conditional catalog. Each entry binds client_id, login_entry_id, tenant policy and Business purpose. No device, scan or OIDC routes. Cookie name/path, origin, token lifetime and mount prefix belong to the host profile. JSON/form bodies are limited to 16384 bytes; all responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Secrets never belong in query parameters. Fixed and Choose are mutually exclusive; registration requires Fixed plus explicit enablement and email service.

get.description: Access/tickets are entry/client/purpose scoped. Optional tenant header must agree with the authenticated context.

post.description: Exact configured Origin AND x-embedded-idp-browser: 1 required; Sec-Fetch-Site, when supplied, must be same-origin. Tenant header forbidden. Refresh cookie is HttpOnly, Secure in HTTPS, SameSite=Strict, entry-specific name/path. Only access token appears in JSON. Browser selection route is present even for Fixed but selection is rejected by policy. Restore rotates; refresh requires expected_session. Logout without cookie is idempotent 204 in normal mode. Development restricted browser mode disables restore/refresh and requires expected_session even for cookie-less logout.

Set-Cookie.description: When rotating/clearing refresh credential; host profile defines exact cookie name/path.

post.description: Access/tickets are entry/client/purpose scoped. Optional tenant header must agree with the authenticated context. New JSON hosts with restricted private-HTTP browser isolation reject browser tickets on token completion. Short persisted source sessions cannot switch into a longer-lived token session; reauthenticate and select through the browser channel. Full-session and LegacyReference behavior is unchanged.

Refresh credential selects tenant and is bound to this entry/client/Business purpose. Tenant and device-proof headers forbidden; proof-bound sessions cannot downgrade. Reuse revocation is committed before 401 refresh_token_reuse_detected. Successful rotation returns status, session and tokens.
